newsitem.title: USA: Regal-Beloit Q1 net falls with sales.
newsitem.headline: Regal-Beloit Q1 net falls with sales.

text.p: Regal-Beloit Corp said Friday a decline in sales contributed to lower earnings in the first quarter.

The company reported net income of $7.7 million, or $0.37 a share, down from $8.8 million, or $0.43, in the same period last year. Sales reached $70.6 million, down from $75.1 million in the first quarter of 1996, before Regal-Beloit's distributor and some of its customers began to reduce their inventories as business slowed down, the company said.
Regal-Beloit, a power transmission equipment and cutting tool maker, said the results were generally in accordance with its 1997 operating plan.
The company's shares were off 1/8 Friday at 23-7/8.
